title: Japan's GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
summary: The GMO Group has urged customers to disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down computers after a threat actor who breached the company's Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to launch a ransomware attack today. [...]
why_it_matters: Ransomware operations combine disruption with extortion, making recovery speed and data-resilience core business risks.
recommendation: Verify offline backups, test restores, harden remote access, and review segmentation to limit lateral movement.

title: Engie confirms customer data breach via marketing platform
summary: Per Bleeping Computer, French energy provider Engie recently confirmed that unauthorized actors accessed customer data following a security breach of a marketing platform utilized by its business partners.
why_it_matters: Breaches and cybercrime activity signal where attackers are focusing and what data types are actively monetized.
